description: Read Discover history and progress for a website, or supply the run ID returned by discovery launch to inspect one study. Distinguishes pending, running, completed, partial, failed and cancelled. limit bounds returned runs (default 10, maximum 20); has_more means older runs remain. This is read-only: it does not start research, monitor in the background or send notifications. Candidate results can be reviewed in the application's Discover page. Requires permission to view prompts; source visibility restrictions still apply.
name: get_prompt_discovery_runs

reason.description: A user-safe sentence explaining a failed, empty or short run, the same line the Discover page shows. Null when there is nothing to explain.

reason_code.description: Why a finished run ended: the terminal reason of a completed run (for example requested_minimum_not_met or coverage_saturated) or the error code of a failed one. Null while the run is in progress or for runs that recorded none.
